tests.1: Rotating right by k: reverse the whole array, then the first k elements, then the rest.
tests.2: k = 0 must leave the array unchanged.
tests.3: k is larger than n: rotating by n changes nothing, so reduce k modulo n first.
tests.4: With n = 1, k mod n is 0.

runtime: k can exceed n: reduce it modulo n before using it as an index.
timeout: Rotating one step at a time is O(n·k); the three reversals are O(n).
